visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins with a close-up of a person's hands placing raw green noodles into a metal blanching basket inside a steaming stainless steel pot. The lighting is bright and industrial. (2) A transition shows the cooked noodles being poured into a black bowl, followed by several shots of the preparation process where braised pork ribs and green vegetables are added to the bowl. (3) A finished bowl of noodle soup is shown on a wooden table, with steam rising from the hot liquid. (4) Close-up shots follow, showing chopsticks lifting the green noodles, drizzling vibrant red chili oil onto them, and showcasing the texture of a piece of braised meat. (5) The scene shifts to the preparation of dry noodles, where a large ladle of sauce and garlic are mixed into a bowl. (6) A clear soup is poured into a small orange bowl. (7) The camera pans out to a wide shot of the small outdoor noodle stall where an older man and a woman in an apron are working behind the counter. (8) The final shots show the interior of the shop with empty tables and a close-up of the shop's sign and exterior location.
